description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_Filter_ExtractStyleBlocks' that extracts and cleans <style> blocks from HTML content, utilizing CSSTidy for CSS cleanup. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library and handles filtering, CSS processing, and context management related to style blocks.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter_ExtractStyleBlocks
classes.description: A filter class that extracts <style> blocks from HTML, cleans them, and stores them in the context for further use.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter and its CSSTidy instance.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Removes inline <style> tags, captures their content, optionally cleans them with CSS tidy, and registers the style blocks in the context.

methods.name: cleanCSS
methods.description: Cleans a CSS string by removing comments, handling scope, validating declarations, and escaping characters if necessary.

methods.name: styleCallback
methods.description: Callback function used in preg_replace_callback to extract style content from <style> tags.
